home.title: MootVote — Private voting on Solana
home.headline: Anonymous, bribery-resistant voting on
home.subhead_line1: MootVote lets you run fully private, verifiable polls, powered by ZK proofs and Solana.
home.subhead_line2: No wallet is required to vote.
home.census_body: The organizer creates a census (list of eligible voters). Members claim a slot with their public key via invite links. You can also import a census created elsewhere.
home.poll_body: Give it a title and choices. Census and description are stored in decentralized storage; the poll (time window, optional fees) goes on Solana.
home.vote_body: Voters prove membership with ZK proofs and encrypt their choice to the tallier. They can vote via relayer (no wallet needed) and use a private re-voting key to change their vote later.
home.tally_body: The tallier decrypts votes and submits ZK proofs of correct counting, making tampering impossible.
home.results_body: After the poll ends and all votes are counted, results are finalized on-chain.
home.security_body: Votes are unlinkable to identities. Membership is proven without disclosure; not even the tallier learns real identities. Bribery is impractical because voters cannot prove how they voted.
home.cta_body: Invite a few participants to start a poll.
home.disclaimer: Disclaimer: this is early software, not yet suitable for high-stakes governance.
